bib.title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
bib.venue: Proceedings of the 2023 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP), pages 6465-6488

read.skipped: Reference list skimmed only; Tables 30-31 (ELI5 examples) skimmed.

question: How well can LLMs, given retrieved passages, answer questions with citations, and can this be evaluated automatically and reproducibly?
contributions: ALCE, the first reproducible benchmark for automatically evaluating LLM generations with citations (ASQA, QAMPARI, ELI5)
Automatic metrics for fluency, correctness and citation quality, with human-correlation evidence
Prompting strategies (VANILLA, SUMM, SNIPPET, INTERACT, INLINESEARCH, CLOSEDBOOK, RERANK, POSTCITE) and analyses of retrieval, context length and synthesis

method.summary: ALCE gives a question and a retrieval corpus of 100-word passages and requires a system to retrieve, answer and cite. Systems are prompted LLMs (no weight updates) with off-the-shelf retrievers; evaluation uses MAUVE for fluency, dataset-specific correctness, and a T5-11B NLI model (TRUE) for citation recall and precision, validated by human annotation.
method.task: long-form question answering with citations (retrieval-augmented generation)

datasets.name: ASQA
datasets.source: Stelmakh et al. 2022; corpus Wikipedia 2018-12-20 snapshot (21M passages)
datasets.preprocessing: corpus split into 100-word passages; human answers average 65 words

datasets.name: QAMPARI
datasets.preprocessing: each entity in generated list treated as a statement; average 13 answers per question

datasets.name: ELI5
datasets.source: Fan et al. 2019; corpus Sphere (899M passages, filtered Common Crawl, Reddit removed)
datasets.preprocessing: human answers average 131 words; 3 sub-claims per question generated by text-davinci-003 from gold answers

models.name: TRUE (google/t5_xxl_true_nli_mixture)
models.architecture: T5, fine-tuned on SNLI, MNLI, Fever, SciTail, PAWS, VitaminC

inference.decoding: ChatGPT and GPT-4: sampling; open-source models: nucleus sampling
inference.samples: 3 runs with different seeds, each sampling 2 demonstrations from a pool of 4; ChatGPT RERANK, ChatGPT-16K and GPT-4 single run; RERANK samples n_sample=4 responses per question
inference.prompting: Instruction plus 2 in-context demonstrations (full instruction Table 23; short instruction Table 24 for 2K-context LLaMA-family models). At most 3 citations per statement; output truncated at new lines before evaluation.
inference.retrieval: top-100 passages retrieved (GTR/DPR for Wikipedia, BM25 for Sphere); top-k in context: k=5 for 4K, k=3 for 2K, 10 for SUMM/SNIPPET, up to 20 for 16K and GPT-4; 100-word passages

parameters.INTERACT: model forced to output after each check; max 3 passages checked at a time; full text removed after one action
parameters.INLINESEARCH: search among top-100 by GTR; best passage shown and removed after one action
parameters.RERANK: n_sample=4, pick by automatic citation recall
parameters.SUMM: summaries within 50 words; SUMM/SNIPPET cut ASQA passage length 6x on average
parameters.MAUVE: question concatenated with output, both truncated to 100 words

metrics.name: MAUVE
metrics.definition: fluency of output vs human text (ASQA, ELI5 only)

metrics.name: EM recall (ASQA)
metrics.definition: share of gold short answers that are exact substrings of the output, with aliases

metrics.name: Recall-5 and precision (QAMPARI)
metrics.definition: exact match to gold list; recall set to 100% if at least 5 correct answers

metrics.name: Claim recall (ELI5)
metrics.definition: share of 3 generated sub-claims entailed by the output per TRUE NLI

metrics.name: Citation recall
metrics.definition: per statement 1 iff at least one citation and concatenated cited passages entail it (NLI); averaged over statements

metrics.name: Citation precision
metrics.definition: per citation 1 iff statement recall=1 and the citation is not 'irrelevant' (alone does not support AND removing it leaves the rest still supporting)

eval.protocol: Mean over 3 seeds (std in Tables 19-21). Human evaluation: Surge AI workers, 100 examples each from ASQA and ELI5, outputs of ChatGPT VANILLA, ChatGPT RERANK, Vicuna-13B VANILLA; utility 1-5, citation recall, citation precision; pay 20 USD per hour.

prompts.text: Write an accurate, engaging, and concise answer for the given question using only the provided search results (some of which might be irrelevant) and cite them properly. Use an unbiased and journalistic tone. Always cite for any factual claim. When citing several search results, use [1][2][3]. Cite at least one document and at most three documents in each sentence. If multiple documents support the sentence, only cite a minimum sufficient subset of the documents.
Write a high-quality answer for the given question using only the provided search results and cite them properly using [1][2][3].

Summarize the following document within 50 words with the question of interest "{QUESTION}" Return "irrelevant" if the document is irrelevant to the question. Try to keep all the important dates, numbers, and names. Title: {TITLE} Text: {TEXT} Summary:

Given the follow passage and the question "{QUESTION}", extract a useful span from the passage that can answer the question. Resolve all the coreference issues to make the extracted span understandable standalone. If the passage is not helpful for answering the question, return "irrelevant". Title: {TITLE} Text: {TEXT} Extracted span:
Write an accurate, engaging, and concise answer for the given question. Use an unbiased and journalistic tone.
Read the original question and passage, and generate 3 additional claims that are supported by the passage and answer the question. (plus 3 hand-written demonstrations from ELI5 train)

limits: MAUVE is sensitive to output length and may be unstable
ELI5 claims may not cover all valid answers
Citation quality is limited by NLI accuracy; cannot detect partial support, so citation precision is lower than human judgement
RERANK uses the same automatic recall score that evaluates it, so its gain is inflated relative to human scores
Datasets do not cover multi-hop reasoning, math or code
Prompting only; training for citations left to future work (no supervised data)
Models (2023 ChatGPT, GPT-4, LLaMA era) have dated; only one seed for RERANK, ChatGPT-16K and GPT-4

terms.definition: 1 iff there is at least one citation and the concatenated cited passages entail the statement
a citation is irrelevant if it cannot support the statement alone and removing it does not affect the others supporting it
